title: 2024 Prizm DP Basketball - Enrique Freeman RC - Purple Wave Prizm - 72 Zips
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks Basketball trading card featuring rookie player Enrique Freeman. This particular card is a Purple Wave parallel, numbered 72 Zips. As a part of the Prizm DP Basketball set by Panini, it offers collectors a unique and limited edition card to add to their sports memorabilia collection.
